bone_tree_legend: P = physics   C = collision root   eye = visibility
renderer_page_phase8_hint: Renderer controls will be added in Phase 8. Raster and path-preview settings remain unchanged.
renderer_page_hint: Path tracing controls live here. Scene selection and Sky Rendering are independent.
path_trace_settings_hint: Physical integrator edits reset accumulation; SPP/maximum change only the schedule, and Film remains display-only.
pt_display_exposure_hint: Applied after linear HDR accumulation; it does not reset history.
pt_nvidia_rt_core_unavailable: Available only on an armed NVIDIA Vulkan ray-tracing device.
pt_spp_unsupported: Adaptive sampling needs the variance/AOV pass and is currently unavailable.
pt_transparent_budget_hint: Transparent traversal consumes both the transparent and total path budgets.
pt_world_lighting_hint: Environment and Sun/Moon master switches are shared with World/Sky.
pt_frame_generation_unavailable: DLSS Frame Generation is unavailable on this GPU/runtime or swapchain.
pt_fg_vulkan_vsync: Vulkan Frame Generation requires VSync Off; XPBD disables it automatically while FG is requested.
pt_reflex_unavailable: NVIDIA Reflex is unavailable on this GPU/runtime.
pt_fg_requires_reflex: Frame Generation requires Reflex; effective Reflex is forced On while FG is requested.
pt_fg_waiting: Frame Generation is requested; waiting for generated presents.
pt_post_unavailable: The requested post-process mode is unavailable; the fallback is shown above.
pt_post_conflict: Ray Reconstruction owns reconstruction; separate SR is disabled.
pt_post_rr_mode_required: Ray Reconstruction requires Quality, Balanced, Performance, or Ultra Performance. Off and DLAA use the fallback path.
pt_film_hint: Film controls are applied after linear HDR accumulation and preserve history.
pt_accumulate_moving_unavailable: Camera reprojection is not available; moving the camera safely resets history.
pt_emissive_mesh_unavailable: Emissive mesh direct sampling currently requires the NVIDIA RT Core path.
pt_timing_status: CPU %.2f ms / GPU %.2f ms / history generation %llu
still_render_hint: Creates an immutable scene, sky, camera, and path-tracing snapshot. Files are written only beside the app in the output folder.
still_raw_accumulation: Render Result uses raw full-resolution sample accumulation. Denoising, SR, RR, adaptive stopping, and dynamic resolution are disabled.
still_requires_rt: Still rendering requires Path Tracing on a supported NVIDIA Vulkan RT device.
sky_page_hint: Choose exactly one sky source. Off is the default and adds no environment light.
sky_scene_independent: Preview Scene controls geometry/lights only; it never changes Sky Rendering.
sky_global_strength_hint: Adjusts the physical lighting energy provided by the sky system. Affects scene lighting, reflections, indirect light, Sun, Moon, clouds, and HDRI. 0 EV equals 1×; each additional EV approximately doubles the energy.
sky_background_exposure_hint: Adjusts only the visible sky background brightness. Does not change scene lighting, reflections, shadows, or path-traced environment energy.
sky_hdri_required: No HDRI imported. User HDRI becomes available after a successful load.
preview_scene_independent: Scene selection is independent from Sky Rendering; use the Sky page for the sky source.
labpbr_suite_import_hint: Import a base PNG with mandatory same-stem _s.png, optional _n.png, and texture.properties.
labpbr_suite_cache_hit: Last import reused the checksum cache.
labpbr_suite_properties_confirmed: Missing properties explicitly confirmed as LabPBR 1.3.
labpbr_suite_source_changed: Source files changed. Reload keeps source data transactional and never overwrites a dirty draft.
labpbr_suite_confirm_body: The base and required _s.png are valid, but no format declaration exists. Import only if this suite is LabPBR 1.3.
labpbr_suite_candidates_body: Multiple complete base + _s pairs were found. Choose the intended base file; no stem is guessed.
labpbr_material_hint: Load base color separately. Import the PBR map and normal map as two individual RGBA PNG files; no folder import is used. Group overrides affect only covered UV texels.
labpbr_load_texture: Load a base texture to author LabPBR maps.
labpbr_specular_none: No RGBA LabPBR specular image imported.
labpbr_select_group: Select a model group in the hierarchy or viewport.
labpbr_conflicts_block_export: Different group values overlap the same atlas texels. Export is blocked until they agree.
labpbr_normal_none: No RGBA LabPBR / Iris normal image imported.
labpbr_export_hint: Writes <stem>_s.png, optional byte-identical <stem>_n.png, and texture.properties after round-trip validation.
labpbr_overwrite_body: The following files already exist. Continuing replaces them as one validated bundle:
joint_spring_help: Requested values are passed to Bullet. Effective solver behavior may be stability-limited and depends on active axes, timestep, substeps, and solver iterations; these are not calibrated physical constants.
rb_max_penetration: Maximum Safe Penetration (Loop / Seam, Bullet units):
rb_max_penetration_help: Excludes unsafe loop cycles and seam corrections and gates loop export. It does not decide source looping or change Bullet contact response, margins, or impulses; non-loop export follows Final Audit policy.
ordinary_edge_blend_hint: Blends an ordinary non-loop bake back to its source pose near the start and end. This is not a loop seam or an A → B transition.
edge_blend_seconds_hint: Controls only the source-edge smoothing window for an ordinary bake.
a_to_b_transition_hint: Creates a dedicated transition output from source A to target B with explicit timing and optional per-bone follow weights.
transition_seconds_hint: Only sets the length of an optional source-to-target transition output. It is not the loop seam duration.
seam_window_hint: Uses the selected clip fraction first, then evaluates larger 37.5% and 50% candidates when needed; the authored end time never changes.
preview_scene_hint: Empty hides current content without deleting it. Presets never change Sky Rendering.
dynamic_preview_scene_unsupported: Dynamic animation is not available for this scene.
ray_tracing_hint: Optional. Hardware-assisted preview lighting on supported NVIDIA GPUs. Default off.
ray_tracing_unsupported: Not available on this GPU — option disabled; using standard preview.
camera_follow_hint: Off by default. When on, camera gently tracks the preview center (no hard snaps).
anim_rest_hint: No clip = rest pose; click/right-click selection again to clear
camera_hint: RMB: pan L/R F/B · Shift+RMB/scroll: height · LMB: orbit · Wheel: zoom
about_desc: Desktop tool for baking Minecraft Bedrock entity physics animations (XPBD / Bullet). C++ GUI port of the original project.
about_licenses_body: This application is Apache-2.0. Third-party notices ship in the notices/ folder next to the executable (for redistribution). Key components: Nuklear, stb_image, SDL3, nlohmann-json, Bullet, spdlog/fmt, Vulkan headers/loader.
source_snapping_detected: Source snapping: %d FPS (%.6f s/frame); strict output: %zu keyframes
source_snapping_undetected: Source snapping could not be detected; strict mode will reject baking. Use Bake FPS mode instead
timing_diagnostics: FPS %d, dt %.6fs, resumed at step %d, completed %d
kinematic_history_diagnostics: Kinematic history: continuous %llu, periodic %llu, resets %llu, rejected %llu
fixed_substep_diagnostics: Fixed substeps: configured %d, last executed %d, average %.2f, max executed %d, risk intervals %llu / %llu
fixed_substep_motion_diagnostics: Worst motion: %s body %s; recommended kinematic %d, dynamic last/max %d/%d; min half extent %.6g, radius %.6g, linear travel %.6g, angular travel %.6g rad, acceleration %.6g
collider_preflight_diagnostics: Bullet colliders: %zu boxes, warnings %d, errors %d; observed half extents %.6g to %.6g, max aspect %.6g, Unit Scale %.6g
collider_risk_diagnostics: %s collider: %s box %d; min/max half extent %.6g / %.6g, aspect %.6g, margin/min %.6g, CCD radius %.6g
velocity_diagnostics: Linear speed max %.6g (%s, frame %d); frame jump %.6g (%s, frame %d)
collision_diagnostics: Contacts initial %d / runtime max %d, final penetration %.6g
initial_collision_warning: Initial Bullet overlap exceeded the warning threshold but remained below the formal failure gate.
joint_diagnostics: Unsafe joints %d, anchor %.6g, angle excess %.6g rad
joint_spring_diagnostics: Joint Spring requested stiffness %.6g / damping %.6g; active joints %d, axes %d; solver %s
joint_spring_effective_behavior: Effective Solver Behavior: Bullet may limit requested stiffness/damping for stability (limitIfNeeded=true); no exact physical effective value is claimed.
joint_half_turn_warning: Joint warning: %s -> %s, %s limit %.6g° is near a half turn (order %s)
loop_diagnostics: Loop cycles %d, converged %s, fallback %s, seam rejected %s
loop_layered_diagnostics: Source %s | Physical %s | Seam %s | Driver %s | Collision %s | Export %s
loop_candidate_diagnostics: Cycle %d | valid %s | score %.4g | pose %.4g | velocity %.4g | contacts %d | penetration %.4g | selected %s
loop_candidate_diagnostics_noncollision: Cycle %d | valid %s | score %.4g | pose %.4g | velocity %.4g | selected %s
loop_seam_window_summary: Loop seam: requested %.1f%% | effective %.3gs (%.1f%% of clip)
loop_window_diagnostics: Window %.3gs (%.1f%%) | C0 %s | C1 %s | C2 %s | Driver %s | Collision %s | Joint %s | %s
export_ready: Animation and velocity exports are ready.
export_blocked: Formal exports are blocked by preflight.
force_export_available: Safety preflight blocked formal export. You may still click Export Anim and confirm a force export.
force_export_warning_body: Safety preflight rejected this bake. Force export may contain visible physics, collision, joint, or loop-seam defects. Continue only if you accept the risk.
no_final_diagnostics: No committed final diagnostics. Step publishes live measurements; Bake finalizes audits.
debug_sample_hint: Off = sample FPS/latency once per second (default). On = every frame.
molang_preserve_body: These channels will be sampled as 0 for physics only. Their original Molang will remain unchanged.
molang_overwrite_body: These channels will receive numeric baked keyframes, replacing their original Molang expressions.
